verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents a dedicated AuthKit CLI Auth API that implements the OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Flow (RFC 8628). It issues a device code and user code, then the CLI polls for tokens, so command-line apps can authenticate users through the browser instead of handling long-lived secrets. Supporting docs show OAuth apps explicitly cover CLI tools, a client-ID-only SDK mode for apps that can't store secrets, and AuthKit as a spec-compatible OAuth authorization server. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the device flow, explicit coverage of fully headless/non-interactive agent scenarios, and depth on token refresh and lifetime handling.
